jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years building server-side applications in JavaScript/TypeScript using Node.js frameworks such as NestJS or Express 3+ years building user-facing features with React, including component-driven development and front-end architecture Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar), including schema design and performance considerations

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. 4+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, building data pipelines, writing complex SQL, and structuring data at scale Google Cloud data technologies experience (BigQuery, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions) or equivalent AWS/Azure data services Hands-on experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling
